plugins.name: VibraVid
plugins.description: Web GUI to search and download movies, series, anime, and albums (HLS/DASH/MP4). Published image from AstraeLabs. Use only with content you have rights to.

install.command:
mkdir -p plugins/vibravid && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opendevtools-org/hub-community-plugins/main/plugins/vibravid/docker-compose.yml -o plugins/vibravid/docker-compose.yml && if ! grep -Fq 'plugins/vibravid/docker-compose.yml' docker-compose.apps.yml 2>/dev/null; then printf '
include:
  - path: plugins/vibravid/docker-compose.yml
    project_directory: .
' >> docker-compose.apps.yml; fi && if [ -f upstream/docker-compose.yml ]; then docker compose --project-directory . -f upstream/docker-compose.yml -f upstream/docker-compose.lan.yml -f docker-compose.apps.yml up -d; else docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.lan.yml -f docker-compose.apps.yml up -d; fi
